tagline: Making life easier for people with intimate and personal medical conditions
hero_kpi_rationale: Stable headcount reflecting overall operational capacity. Coloplast maintains a global presence with 16,983 average employees (Q1 2025/26), a key indicator of its operational scale in specialized medical care and its ability to deliver 6% organic growth.

kpis.name: Average Total Headcount
kpis.explanation: Average number of full-time equivalent employees (FTEs) employed by Coloplast worldwide.
kpis.description: Coloplast employed an average of 16,983 full-time equivalent employees (FTEs) in Q1 2025/26, up from 16,628 FTEs in Q1 2024/25, reflecting an increase of 355 FTEs (+2.1%). This headcount growth supports the company's Impact4 strategy and operational investments.
kpis.signal: Moderate headcount growth supporting 6% organic growth
